title: Microsoft Releases Its First Cybersecurity AI Model MAI-Cyber-1-Flash and Launches the Perception Security Platform
excerpt: Microsoft recently officially launched its first specialized cybersecurity model, MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, and a new AI cybersecurity platform called Perception, duri
content_html:
Microsoft recently officially launched its first specialized cybersecurity model, MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, and a new AI cybersecurity platform called Perception, during an event in San Francisco, further strengthening its position in the field of artificial intelligence security and competing with companies such as Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI.

Microsoft stated that MAI-Cyber-1-Flash is a model specifically designed for cybersecurity scenarios, aiming to identify complex vulnerabilities in codebases and provide core capabilities to Microsoft's vulnerability identification and remediation tool MDASH. Combined with the Perception platform, this model can help enterprises automate security processes such as vulnerability discovery, analysis, and remediation.

Mustafa Suleyman, Microsoft's AI CEO, said that the company has integrated MAI-1Cyber Flash with GPT5.4 within the MDASH framework and outperformed competing models such as Gemini, GPT5.5Cyber, GPT5.6Sol, and Mythos5 in the Cyber Gym cybersecurity benchmark test. Microsoft claims that the model offers advantages in both performance and cost efficiency and plans to immediately deploy it in production environments.

At the same time, the Perception platform introduced by Microsoft uses a multi-agent collaboration architecture, consisting of three types of AI agents: red team, blue team, and green team. The red team agent simulates potential attack behaviors and analyzes threat paths; the blue team agent is used to detect and classify vulnerabilities; and the green team agent performs vulnerability remediation and security optimization tasks.

Hayete Gallot, Microsoft's Vice President of Security, stated that as hackers increasingly use AI to launch attacks, companies need to leverage AI to improve defense efficiency. Perception aims to help security teams use AI for protection at speeds and scales comparable to attackers.

David Weston, Chief Engineer of Perception, said that previously, security teams needed multiple professionals to spend hours completing vulnerability detection and remediation, but with AI agent collaboration, enterprises can now complete vulnerability discovery, prioritization, security testing, and code fixes within minutes.

content_html_zh:
微软近日在旧金山举行的一次活动中正式推出了其首个专门的网络安全模型MAI-Cyber​​-1-Flash以及名为Perception的全新人工智能网络安全平台，进一步巩固了其在人工智能安全领域的地位，并与Anthropic、Google、OpenAI等公司展开竞争。

微软表示，MAI-Cyber​​-1-Flash是专门针对网络安全场景设计的模型，旨在识别代码库中的复杂漏洞，并为微软的漏洞识别和修复工具MDASH提供核心能力。 结合Perception平台，该模型可以帮助企业自动化漏洞发现、分析和修复等安全流程。

微软AI首席执行官Mustafa Suleyman表示，该公司已将MAI-1Cyber​​ Flash与GPT5.4集成在MDASH框架内，并在Cyber​​ Gym网络安全基准测试中优于Gemini、GPT5.5Cyber​​、GPT5.6Sol和Mythos5等竞争模型。 微软声称该模型在性能和成本效率方面都具有优势，并计划立即将其部署到生产环境中。

同时，微软推出的Perception平台采用多智能体协作架构，由红队、蓝队、绿队三类AI智能体组成。 红队代理模拟潜在的攻击行为并分析威胁路径；蓝队代理用于漏洞检测和分类；绿队代理执行漏洞修复和安全优化任务。

微软安全副总裁Hayete Gallot表示，随着黑客越来越多地利用AI发起攻击，企业需要利用AI来提高防御效率。 Perception 旨在帮助安全团队以与攻击者相当的速度和规模使用人工智能进行保护。

Perception首席工程师David Weston表示，此前，安全团队需要多名专业人员花费数小时完成漏洞检测和修复，但通过AI代理协作，企业现在可以在几分钟内完成漏洞发现、优先级排序、安全测试和代码修复。
